repo.name: Megatron-Bridge

detail.body:
Kimi K3 has native model and checkpoint-conversion support but no library pretraining recipe. Add `kimi_k3_pretrain_config`, documented as **early, perf not optimized**, and export it for the standard `scripts/training/run_recipe.py` entry point.

**Unsupported parallelism:** Context parallelism (CP > 1) and virtual pipeline parallelism (VPP) are not supported by the current Kimi K3 implementation. Keep `context_parallel_size=1` and `virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size=None`; the model rejects CP > 1 and any non-`None` VPP setting.

The recipe uses 512 GB200 GPUs with TP4/PP4/EP128, a 24/23/23/23 pipeline split, BF16, full activation recomputation, distributed Adam, 8K sequences, and global batch 128. Real K3-tokenized indexed RP2 and HF checkpoint initialization are supplied through standard runner overrides. The learning-rate schedule retains its full warmup/decay horizon when the trial is shortened.

The recipe includes the explicit K3 tokenizer vocabulary path and previously checked transport/FLA forward controls. These controls preserve kernel arithmetic; they do not claim to repair underlying runtime libraries or optimize performance. Tokenizer initialization now preserves explicit options when training validation reruns its initialization method; absent deprecated kwargs previously reset `trust_remote_code=True` to false. Regression tests cover validation reentry and direct/legacy option precedence. The README provides the standard launch command and measured validation limits.

Validation:

- All repository pre-commit hooks passed. Six focused recipe/tokenizer tests passed in the cluster runtime.
- The standard runner completed ten training iterations on real RP2 at sequence length 8192 across 512 GB200 GPUs / 128 nodes. All 512 rank exit records passed; the resolved config and logs were independently checked.
- Loss stayed between 1.516120 and 1.573577; gradient norms were finite and positive (0.452–0.703). Every iteration had zero skipped/NaN counts. No OOM occurred, so no 4K fallback was needed. The run consumed 1280 sequences (10,485,760 tokens).
- Total allocation time was 17m17s, including setup and compilation. This is not an optimized performance measurement. The standard scheduler starts the first iteration at zero learning rate.
- Independent code and saved-result reviews passed. Earlier faithful tiny training and full-model frozen-forward checks also passed.

The short trial establishes a functional 8K recipe. It does not establish independent full-model loss agreement, long-run convergence, or checkpoint save/resume correctness; checkpoint saving was disabled. Keep the recipe labeled early and performance unoptimized.

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+# Kimi K3 pretraining
+
+`kimi_k3_pretrain_config` is **early, perf not optimized**. It uses the native
+K3 provider with TP4/PP4/EP128 on 512 GB200 GPUs, BF16, full activation
+recomputation, and distributed Adam. The uneven pipeline has 24/23/23/23 layers.
+
+**Context parallelism (CP > 1) and virtual pipeline parallelism (VPP) are not
+supported by the current Kimi K3 implementation.** Keep
+`context_parallel_size=1` and `virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size=None`.
+The model rejects CP > 1 and any non-`None` VPP setting.
+
+Launch with the standard recipe runner inside your allocation:
+
+```bash
+export KIMI_K3_HF_PATH="$KIMI_SNAPSHOT"
+export FLA_CACHE_MODE=always NCCL_PXN_DISABLE=1 CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1
+uv run python scripts/training/run_recipe.py \
+  --recipe kimi_k3_pretrain_config \
+  --pretrained_checkpoint "$KIMI_SNAPSHOT" \
+  --seq_length 8192 --max_steps 10 \
+  dataset.blend="[['$RP2_TRAIN_PREFIX'],null]" "dataset.split='100,0,0'" \
+  dataset.path_to_cache="$DATA_CACHE" \
+  validation.eval_iters=0 \
+  checkpoint.save=null checkpoint.load=null
+```
+
+Provide an existing indexed RP2 `.bin`/`.idx` pair tokenized with the K3
+snapshot tokenizer. The example consumes only the training prefix; held-out
+RP2 documents should be prepared separately. The default recipe's dataset
+placeholder must be replaced for real-data training. Configure tokenizer,
+cache, temporary, logger, and checkpoint paths for your allocation. For an
+offline snapshot set `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` and `TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1` as well.
+
+The first functional attempt uses 8192 tokens. If it OOMs, preserve the error
+and memory logs before retrying `--seq_length 4096`; the initial validation
+plan does not go below 4096. Keep the external one-hour limit for this trial.
+The 100-step warmup and 10000-step cosine horizon remain unchanged when
+`--max_steps` is reduced. Standard scheduler initialization starts at zero
+learning rate and advances after each update.
+
+The recipe retains two controls from prior diagnostics: `NCCL_PXN_DISABLE=1`
+for an observed expert all-to-all transport failure, and fixed KDA/gated-norm
+forward tuning configurations for otherwise identical BF16 replicas. The
+pre-wrap hook installs these through the investigated FLA 0.5.2/Triton APIs,
+preserves kernel arithmetic, and verifies selected configurations after each
+forward. These controls do not repair underlying runtime libraries.
+`FLA_CACHE_MODE=always` adds file reads and is diagnostic overhead. Backward
+kernels retain the installed autotuner.
+
+The full 8K standard-runner trial completed ten training iterations on real
+RP2 with 512 GB200 GPUs across 128 nodes. All ranks exited successfully, loss
+remained between 1.516120 and 1.573577, and gradient norms remained finite and
+positive. There were no skipped or NaN iterations and no OOM; a 4K fallback
+was unnecessary. All six focused recipe/tokenizer tests passed in the same
+allocation. The allocation ran for 17 minutes 17 seconds, including setup
+and compilation; this is not an optimized performance measurement.
+
+These results establish short-run functionality. They do not establish
+independent full-model loss agreement, long-run convergence, or checkpoint
+save/resume correctness; checkpoint saving was disabled for this trial.

+"""Early Kimi K3 pretraining recipe."""
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
+
+from megatron.bridge import AutoBridge
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.common import _pretrain_common
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.kimi.kimi_k3_runtime import configure_kimi_k3_kernels
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.utils.environment_utils import COMMON_RECIPE_ENV_VARS
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.utils.optimizer_utils import distributed_fused_adam_with_cosine_annealing
+from megatron.bridge.training.config import ConfigContainer
+
+
+def kimi_k3_pretrain_config() -> ConfigContainer:
+    """Kimi K3 BF16 pretraining on 512 GB200 GPUs: early, perf not optimized.
+
+    Uses TP4/PP4/EP128, an uneven 24/23/23/23 pipeline, full activation
+    recomputation, and distributed Adam. Training at 8192 tokens is under
+    validation; neither convergence nor independent full-model loss agreement
+    is established. Use 4096 only as an OOM fallback for the initial trial.
+
+    Context parallelism (CP > 1) and virtual pipeline parallelism (VPP) are
+    not supported by the current Kimi K3 implementation. Keep
+    ``context_parallel_size=1`` and ``virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size=None``.
+    The model rejects CP > 1 and any non-None VPP setting.
+
+    Launch with ``scripts/training/run_recipe.py --recipe kimi_k3_pretrain_config``.
+    Set ``KIMI_K3_HF_PATH`` to an existing local snapshot when offline. Supply
+    real, K3-tokenized RP2 through ``dataset.blend`` or ``dataset.blend_per_split``
+    and initialize from the snapshot with ``checkpoint.pretrained_checkpoint``.
+    The default dataset placeholder must be replaced for a real-data run.
+
+    The PXN transport mitigation and fixed FLA forward configurations retain
+    the investigated runtime behavior; they are not performance optimizations.
+    Keep the full learning-rate horizon when shortening train.train_iters.
+    """
+    hf_path = os.environ.get("KIMI_K3_HF_PATH", "moonshotai/Kimi-K3")
+    cfg = _pretrain_common()
+    cfg.model = AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained(hf_path, trust_remote_code=True).to_megatron_provider(load_weights=False)
+    cfg.model.tensor_model_parallel_size = 4
+    cfg.model.pipeline_model_parallel_size = 4
+    cfg.model.num_layers_in_first_pipeline_stage = 24
+    cfg.model.num_layers_in_last_pipeline_stage = None
+    cfg.model.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size = None
+    cfg.model.context_parallel_size = 1
+    cfg.model.expert_model_parallel_size = 128
+    cfg.model.expert_tensor_parallel_size = 1
+    cfg.model.sequence_parallel = True
+    cfg.model.variable_seq_lengths = True
+    cfg.model.overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm = False
+    cfg.model.seq_length = 8192
+    cfg.model.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    cfg.model.pipeline_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    cfg.model.gradient_accumulation_fusion = False
+    cfg.model.recompute_granularity = "full"
+    cfg.model.recompute_method = "uniform"
+    cfg.model.recompute_num_layers = 1
+    cfg.model.register_pre_wrap_hook(configure_kimi_k3_kernels)
+
+    cfg.train.train_iters = 10000
+    cfg.train.global_batch_size = 128
+    cfg.train.micro_batch_size = 1
+    cfg.optimizer, cfg.scheduler = distributed_fused_adam_with_cosine_annealing(
+        max_lr=1e-5,
+        min_lr=0.0,
+        lr_warmup_iters=100,
+        lr_decay_iters=10000,
+        weight_decay=0.1,
+        start_weight_decay=0.1,
+        end_weight_decay=0.1,
+        clip_grad=1.0,
+    )
+    cfg.optimizer.use_precision_aware_optimizer = False
+    cfg.ddp.use_distributed_optimizer = True
+    cfg.ddp.grad_reduce_in_fp32 = True
+    cfg.ddp.overlap_grad_reduce = False
+    cfg.ddp.overlap_param_gather = False
+    cfg.ddp.average_in_collective = False
+    cfg.ddp.check_for_nan_in_grad = True
+    cfg.comm_overlap = None
+
+    cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_type = "HuggingFaceTokenizer"
+    cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_model = hf_path
+    cfg.tokenizer.vocab_file = (
+        str(Path(hf_path) / "tiktoken.model") if Path(hf_path).is_dir() else hf_hub_download(hf_path, "tiktoken.model")
+    )
+    cfg.tokenizer.trust_remote_code = True
+    cfg.tokenizer.use_tokenizer_vocab_size = False
+    cfg.tokenizer.vocab_size = cfg.model.vocab_size
+    cfg.dataset.seq_length = 8192
+    cfg.dataset.num_workers = 2
+    cfg.dataset.skip_getting_attention_mask_from_dataset = True
+    cfg.dataset.reset_attention_mask = False
+    cfg.dataset.reset_position_ids = False
+    cfg.dataset.eod_mask_loss = False
+    cfg.checkpoint.hf_trust_remote_code = True
+    cfg.logger.log_interval = 1
+    cfg.logger.log_memory_interval = 1
+    cfg.env_vars = {**COMMON_RECIPE_ENV_VARS, "NCCL_PXN_DISABLE": "1", "FLA_CACHE_MODE": "always"}
+    return cfg

+"""Apply recorded FLA forward configurations without changing kernel arithmetic."""
+
+import importlib
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable
+
+import torch
+
+
+def config_dict(config) -> dict:
+    """Serialize the fields used by the installed Triton configuration API."""
+    return {
+        "kwargs": config.kwargs,
+        "num_warps": config.num_warps,
+        "num_stages": config.num_stages,
+        "num_ctas": config.num_ctas,
+        "maxnreg": config.maxnreg,
+    }
+
+
+def install_controls(output: Path, rank: int) -> Callable[[], dict]:
+    """Constrain forward tuning and return a verifier of configurations actually used."""
+    import triton
+    from fla.modules import fused_norm_gate
+    from fla.ops.utils.cache import FLA_CACHE_MODE, FlaCacheMode
+    from fla.utils import autotune_cache_kwargs
+
+    assert FLA_CACHE_MODE is FlaCacheMode.ALWAYS
+    records = {
+        "fla.modules.l2norm.l2norm_fwd_kernel/0": {
+            "kwargs": {"BT": 8},
+            "num_warps": 8,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 3,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+        "fla.ops.common.chunk_delta_h.chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_kernel_h_blockdim64/1": {
+            "kwargs": {"BV": 32},
+            "num_warps": 2,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 3,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+        "fla.ops.gla.chunk.chunk_gla_fwd_kernel_o/1": {
+            "kwargs": {"BK": 64, "BV": 64},
+            "num_warps": 4,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 2,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+        "fla.ops.kda.wy_fast.recompute_w_u_fwd_kda_kernel/1": {
+            "kwargs": {},
+            "num_warps": 8,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 4,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+        "fla.ops.kda.chunk_intra.chunk_kda_fwd_kernel_inter_solve_fused/1": {
+            "kwargs": {"BK": 64},
+            "num_warps": 4,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 3,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+        "fla.ops.kda.chunk_intra.chunk_kda_fwd_kernel_intra_sub_chunk/1": {
+            "kwargs": {},
+            "num_warps": 1,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 3,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+        "fla.ops.kda.gate.kda_gate_chunk_cumsum_vector_kernel/1": {
+            "kwargs": {"BS": 32},
+            "num_warps": 4,
+            "num_ctas": 1,
+            "num_stages": 3,
+            "maxnreg": None,
+        },
+    }
+    config_dir = output / f"configs-rank-{rank}"
+    config_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    os.environ["FLA_CONFIG_DIR"] = str(config_dir)
+    objects = {}
+    for path, config in records.items():
+        name, depth = path.split("/")
+        module, attr = name.rsplit(".", 1)
+        obj = getattr(importlib.import_module(module), attr)
+        for _ in range(int(depth)):
+            obj = obj.fn
+        assert type(obj).__name__ == "CachedAutotuner"
+        (config_dir / f"{obj.kernel_name}.json").write_text(
+            json.dumps({"kernel_name": obj.kernel_name, "default_config": config})
+        )
+        objects[path] = obj
+    norm_config = {"kwargs": {"BT": 16}, "num_warps": 4, "num_stages": 3, "num_ctas": 1, "maxnreg": None}
+    original = fused_norm_gate.layer_norm_gated_fwd_kernel.fn
+    assert type(original).__name__ == "Autotuner"
+    assert norm_config in [config_dict(config) for config in original.configs]
+    keys = ["D", "NB", "IS_RMS_NORM", "STORE_RESIDUAL_OUT", "HAS_RESIDUAL", "HAS_WEIGHT"]
+    # Keep the original JIT body and outer pointer-presence heuristics.
+    tuner = triton.autotune(configs=[triton.Config(**norm_config)], key=keys, **autotune_cache_kwargs)(original.fn)
+    fused_norm_gate.layer_norm_gated_fwd_kernel.fn = tuner
+
+    def verify() -> dict:
+        actual = {}
+        for path, obj in objects.items():
+            selected = config_dict(obj.best_config)
+            assert selected == records[path], (path, selected)
+            actual[path] = selected
+        actual["gated_norm"] = config_dict(tuner.best_config)
+        assert actual["gated_norm"] == norm_config
+        return actual
+
+    return verify
+
+
+def configure_kimi_k3_kernels(models: list[torch.nn.Module]) -> list[torch.nn.Module]:
+    """Install early-recipe forward controls before the first training forward."""
+    output = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "kimi-k3-kernels"
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    verify = install_controls(output, torch.distributed.get_rank())
+
+    def verify_forward(module, inputs, result):
+        verify()
+
+    for model in models:
+        model.register_forward_hook(verify_forward)
+    return models

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+"""K3 recipe integration without checkpoint downloads or model allocations."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+import pytest
+
+import megatron.bridge.recipes as recipes
+from megatron.bridge.models.kimi.kimi_k3_provider import KimiK3ModelProvider
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.kimi import kimi_k3
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.kimi.kimi_k3_runtime import configure_kimi_k3_kernels
+from megatron.bridge.training.tokenizers.config import TokenizerConfig
+from megatron.bridge.training.utils.omegaconf_utils import process_config_with_overrides
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def offline_bridge(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(kimi_k3, "hf_hub_download", lambda *args: str(tmp_path / "tiktoken.model"))
+    provider = KimiK3ModelProvider(num_layers=93, hidden_size=7168, num_attention_heads=96, vocab_size=163840)
+    bridge = MagicMock()
+    bridge.to_megatron_provider.return_value = provider
+    constructor = MagicMock(return_value=bridge)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(kimi_k3.AutoBridge, "from_hf_pretrained", constructor)
+    return constructor, bridge, provider
+
+
+def test_registered_recipe_preserves_native_provider_and_pipeline(offline_bridge):
+    _, bridge, provider = offline_bridge
+    cfg = recipes.kimi_k3_pretrain_config()
+    assert cfg.model is provider
+    bridge.to_megatron_provider.assert_called_once_with(load_weights=False)
+    assert cfg.model.variable_seq_lengths
+    assert cfg.model.num_layers == 93
+    first = cfg.model.num_layers_in_first_pipeline_stage
+    pp = cfg.model.pipeline_model_parallel_size
+    assert (first, (cfg.model.num_layers - first) // (pp - 1)) == (24, 23)
+    assert cfg.model.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size is None
+    assert cfg.model.context_parallel_size == 1
+    assert not cfg.model.overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm
+    dp = 512 // cfg.model.tensor_model_parallel_size // pp
+    assert dp == 32
+    assert cfg.train.global_batch_size // (cfg.train.micro_batch_size * dp) == 4
+    assert configure_kimi_k3_kernels in cfg.model._pre_wrap_hooks
+
+
+def test_local_snapshot_and_short_run_keep_optimizer_contract(offline_bridge, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    constructor, _, _ = offline_bridge
+    (tmp_path / "snapshot").mkdir()
+    snapshot = str(tmp_path / "snapshot")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("KIMI_K3_HF_PATH", snapshot)
+    cfg = kimi_k3.kimi_k3_pretrain_config()
+    constructor.assert_called_once_with(snapshot, trust_remote_code=True)
+    assert cfg.tokenizer.tokenizer_model == snapshot
+    assert cfg.tokenizer.vocab_file == str(tmp_path / "snapshot" / "tiktoken.model")
+    assert not cfg.tokenizer.use_tokenizer_vocab_size
+    cfg.train.train_iters = 10
+    assert cfg.scheduler.lr_decay_iters == 10000
+    assert cfg.scheduler.lr_warmup_iters == 100
+    assert cfg.optimizer.use_distributed_optimizer
+    assert not cfg.optimizer.use_precision_aware_optimizer
+    assert cfg.optimizer.bf16 and not cfg.optimizer.fp16
+    assert cfg.ddp.check_for_nan_in_grad and cfg.ddp.grad_reduce_in_fp32
+    assert cfg.rerun_state_machine.check_for_nan_in_loss
+    assert not cfg.ddp.overlap_grad_reduce and not cfg.ddp.overlap_param_gather
+    assert cfg.model.recompute_granularity == "full"
+    assert cfg.model.recompute_num_layers == 1
+    assert cfg.dataset.seq_length == cfg.model.seq_length == 8192
+    assert "early, perf not optimized" in kimi_k3.kimi_k3_pretrain_config.__doc__
+
+
+def test_runner_overrides_preserve_k3_tokenizer_and_hook(offline_bridge):
+    cfg = kimi_k3.kimi_k3_pretrain_config()
+    cfg = process_config_with_overrides(
+        cfg,
+        cli_overrides=[
+            "train.train_iters=10",
+            "dataset.seq_length=8192",
+            "dataset.split='100,0,0'",
+            "checkpoint.save=null",
+        ],
+    )
+    # ConfigContainer.validate reruns initialization for subconfigs without finalize.
+    cfg.tokenizer.__post_init__()
+    assert cfg.tokenizer.trust_remote_code is True
+    assert cfg.tokenizer.vocab_file.endswith("tiktoken.model")
+    assert configure_kimi_k3_kernels in cfg.model._pre_wrap_hooks
+    assert cfg.scheduler.lr_decay_iters == 10000
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("legacy_kwargs", [{}, None])
+def test_direct_tokenizer_options_survive_reconstruction(legacy_kwargs):
+    cfg = TokenizerConfig(
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        tokenizer_hf_no_use_fast=True,
+        tokenizer_hf_no_include_special_tokens=True,
+        hf_tokenizer_kwargs=legacy_kwargs,
+    )
+    copied = replace(cfg, tokenizer_model="local-snapshot")
+    assert copied.trust_remote_code is True
+    assert copied.tokenizer_hf_no_use_fast is True
+    assert copied.tokenizer_hf_no_include_special_tokens is True
+
+
+def test_explicit_legacy_tokenizer_options_keep_precedence():
+    cfg = TokenizerConfig(
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        tokenizer_hf_no_use_fast=True,
+        tokenizer_hf_no_include_special_tokens=True,
+        hf_tokenizer_kwargs={"trust_remote_code": False, "use_fast": True, "include_special_tokens": True},
+    )
+    assert cfg.trust_remote_code is False
+    assert cfg.tokenizer_hf_no_use_fast is False
+    assert cfg.tokenizer_hf_no_include_special_tokens is False
